name: Estonian Transport Administration (Transpordiamet) notices
gives: Joint Estonia-Finland navigation warning on GNSS interference in the Gulf of Finland (17 Jun 2025)

licence: Not checked; Estonian public authority news item

name: EASA GNSS outages and alterations: affected FIRs

notes: Feeds the home board's EASA card and, from events v1.1, rule D1: a 7-day spoofing mark on every FIR of a country stand-in (Natural Earth outlines, tools/fir_approx.py) makes a week-long notice. EASA doesn't define its spoofing and reported marks beyond 'src: ads-b data and reports' (meaning unverified). History: daily copies from 26 Oct 2026 (tools/notice_capture.py) and 16 Internet Archive copies with tables, Sep 2025 to Oct 2026 (tools/easa_history.py), kept in the private archive. Credit 'Source: EASA' with a link.

name: OpenStreetMap land polygons (osmdata.openstreetmap.de)
gives: Land polygons from OSM coastlines, incl. small islands and skerries Natural Earth misses
licence: ODbL 1.0 (OpenStreetMap contributors)

Natural Earth 10 m misses the Archipelago Sea and Gulf of Finland skerries, which made 2,606 of 2,625 Archipelago Sea detections 'dark' on the 24 Oct development pass.

name: SatBeams footprint maps and KML

Site terms bar reproducing or commercially exploiting any part of the service and assert Satbeams' or its licensors' rights in published material (terms updated 6 Jul 2026); KML files are licensed for internal use within the licensee's company only, non-transferable, with a copyright statement on any product (KML terms, 2023). The disclaimers say footprints may be predicted or illustrative

An analyst who holds a KML licence can load the file into the GEO globe's footprint-file control: it is read in their browser and never uploaded, which stays inside internal use. Sources: satbeams.com/terms, market.satbeams.com/website/kml-files-terms-and-conditions, satbeams.com/disclaimers.

name: Satellite operators' coverage maps
gives: Published beam coverage and EIRP contour maps for operators' own satellites (Intelsat, SES, Eutelsat and others)
licence: Each operator's own site terms; no reuse licence found for the maps. Treated as copyrighted images
notes: Not redrawn. An analyst can load a coverage file they hold into the GEO globe locally. Revisit operator by operator if one publishes maps under an open licence.

name: FCC space station filings (Schedule S beam contours)
gives: Beam gain contours for US-licensed satellites, filed with applications as GIMS/GXT files (47 CFR 25.114)
access: FCC ICFS (older IBFS filings also mirrored by fcc.report)
licence: Public records filed with the FCC. The filings are the applicants' work, not US government works, and no reuse terms are stated; some filings give only representative beams
notes: The most promising licence route for published footprints. Before drawing any contour: confirm whether ICFS attachments download without a login, read the GXT format, and decide (Tom) whether contour coordinates from public filings may be redrawn with citation.

name: ITU space network filings (SNL; GIMS beam data)

licence: The Space Network List is free to consult online; beam data ships with ITU's paid BR IFIC publications under ITU terms
notes: Not used. Check what the free SNL gives per network (orbital position, frequency bands, administration) before any use; the GIMS beam data is out unless ITU's terms allow it.
